bio: Hello! I'm Galin, a web and software developer who treats programming like a game. I build backend services with Java & Spring and compose frontend experiences with Vue or vanilla JS. Outside of work, I enjoy gaming, creating fantasy worlds through art and stories, and constantly dabble in new hobbies for fun and to learn new things.
cvSummary: Web and software developer from Kazanlak, Bulgaria. I design and build websites for businesses and web applications in Java and Spring, with a focus on speed, clarity and sites that are easy to maintain.
